snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.4 - Birthday Bonanza + Bug fixes and new features!
snippet.description:
To celebrate Chris's 29th birthday, I have dedicated this update just to him (I'm 3 days late but I can still make an update about it)!

↓ ↓ ↓ Update V1.4 Log ↓ ↓ ↓

- Added the new Birthday Bonanza mode: Experience the classic game in a new way in celebration of Chris's birthday! (THIS IS A HEAVY WORK IN PROGRESS MODE)
- Added the new "everyoneishere" mode: A tough challenge bringing in well known characters from media and real life!
- Added Snek[1]
- Added CaseOh[2]
- Added Wallace[3]
- Tweaked AI, characters should no longer try to pass each other. This is not perfect yet.
- Fixed Super Hard Mode detention UI
- Updated character billboarding: Characters will no longer always face the player. This was fixed as almost all the characters were easily cheated.

[1] Snek has similar mechanics to Arts And Crafters from Baldi's Basics. He is initially active at 2 stress toys, but will become enraged at 5 stress toys. When enraged, Snek will charge at the player, sending them near Chris's location.
[2] CaseOh has similar mechanics to Keith, except with some changes. He is a character exclusive to the secret "everyoneishere" mode CaseOh becomes active at 2 stress toys, and is harmless to begin with. When the player picks up an item, CaseOh will detect it, and will begin moving towards the player, and upon colliding with the player, he will eat their item.
[3] Wallace is a character exclusive to the secret "everybodyishere" mode. Becoming active at 2 stress toys, Wallace will roam the map. When he sees the player, he will play a voiceline and chase the player down. When Wallace collides with the player, they will get cheesed for 5 seconds, limiting their vision and movement.

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in the game are created by me!
